  1. 3He-4He QUANTUM PHASE SEPARATION & CONVECTIVE DILUTION MECHANISM:
     Below the tricritical temperature (T_tricritical = 867 mK, mole fraction x_3 ~ 0.67), the homogeneous liquid

       a. Concentrated Phase (Rich Phase): Floats on top, composed of virtually 100% pure 3He fermion liquid
          with Fermi temperature T_F ~ 450 mK and low molar density (rho ~ 0.081 g/cm^3).
       b. Dilute Phase (Poor Phase): Heavier liquid phase occupying the bottom, composed of degenerate 3He quasiparticles
          dissolved in a superfluid 4He Bose-Einstein condensate background. In the zero-temperature limit (T -> 0 K),
          the finite residual solubility of 3He in 4He approaches exactly x_3,0 = 6.6% (0.066) due to the difference
          between the 3He-3He binding energy (-2.48 K per atom) and the 3He-4He effective potential well (-2.79 K).

     Endothermic dissolution of 3He across the phase boundary in the Mixing Chamber produces net cooling power:
         Q_dot_MC = n_dot_3 * [H_dilute(T_MC) - H_concentrated(T_return)]   [Watts]
     Using degenerate Fermi liquid enthalpy approximations:
         H_dilute(T) = 96.0 * T^2       [J / (mol * K^2)]

     Thus, when incoming concentrated 3He is precooled to T_return ~ T_MC by counterflow step heat exchangers:
         Q_dot_MC_ideal = 84.0 * n_dot_3 * T_MC^2   [Watts, for T in Kelvin]
                        = 84.0 * 10^-6 * n_dot_3_umol_s * (T_MC_mK * 10^-3)^2 * 10^6   [micro-Watts]
                        = 8.4E-5 * n_dot_3_umol_s * (T_MC_mK)^2                         [uW]

  2. CONTINUOUS STILL DISTILLATION THERMODYNAMICS & 4He SUPERFLUID ROLLIN FILM SUPPRESSION:
     The Still vessel operates in the 600 mK to 900 mK temperature regime, functioning as an isotopic distillation
     column under high vacuum (P_still ~ 1.0E-3 to 8.0E-2 mbar).
     At T_still = 700 mK:
       - 3He saturated vapor pressure: P_sat,3 ~ 0.065 mbar
       - 4He saturated vapor pressure: P_sat,4 ~ 0.0006 mbar

  3. 1-KELVIN POT & JOULE-THOMSON (J-T) CONDENSATION CLOSED-LOOP:
     The 1K Pot stage acts as the primary heat sink (T_1K ~ 1.15 K to 1.50 K) that precools and condenses incoming

     The Joule-Thomson expansion valve (stepper-driven micro-metering needle valve or flow impedance) regulates

     Thermodynamic Joule-Thomson coefficient:
         mu_JT = (del T / del P)_H = (1 / C_p) * [ T * (del V / del T)_P - V ]
     At T < 4.2 K, 3He is well below its inversion temperature (~40 K); therefore, expansion (del P < 0) always

  4. STATE-SPACE 4x4 MULTI-INPUT MULTI-OUTPUT (MIMO) DYNAMICS & MPC FORMULATION:
     State vector:        x(k) = [ Delta T_still [mK], Delta n_dot_3 [umol/s], Delta T_1K [mK], Delta P_cond [mbar] ]^T
     Control vector:      u(k) = [ Delta Q_still_heater [uW], Delta u_JT_valve [%] ]^T
     Disturbance vector:  d(k) = [ Delta Q_MC_load [uW], Delta T_4K_PulseTube [mK] ]^T
     Discrete state evolution (sample time Ts = 100 ms):
         x(k+1) = A_d * x(k) + B_d * u(k) + E_d * d(k)
         y(k)   = C_d * x(k) + D_d * u(k)
     Model Predictive Control (MPC) quadratic objective with diagonal weights Q, R, and S (slew penalty):
         J(u) = Sum_{i=1..Np} (x(k+i)^T * Q * x(k+i)) + Sum_{j=0..Nu-1} (u(k+j)^T * R * u(k+j) + Delta u(k+j)^T * S * Delta u(k+j))
     A real-time projected gradient descent solver performs constrained quadratic minimization within the cyclic task.

  5. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR ENGINES:
     Ultra-low noise Ruthenium Oxide (RuO2) and Germanium resistance thermometers are evaluated across three
     isolated 4-wire AC bridge measurement channels for both the Still and 1K Pot stages.
     The 2oo3 voting engine executes range checks, pairwise discrepancy analysis, median extraction, automated
     quarantine of drifted sensors, seamless 1oo2 fallback, and graceful degradation to feedforward safe hold.
========================================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    (* Master Execution & Safety System Interlocks *)

    bEStopOk                        : BOOL;     (* Cryogenic vacuum & pressure safety loop healthy (SIL-3) *)
    bResetAlarms                    : BOOL;     (* Operator manual alarm acknowledge & latch reset *)

    (* Closed-Loop Engineering Recipe Setpoints *)
    rTargetStillTemp_mK             : REAL;     (* Still distillation operating setpoint [mK] (typ. 650 - 850 mK) *)
    rTarget1KPotTemp_K              : REAL;     (* 1K Pot condensing target temperature [K] (typ. 1.20 - 1.45 K) *)

    rTargetCondensingPress_mbar     : REAL;     (* Optimal condensing backpressure setpoint [mbar] (typ. 400 - 900 mbar) *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT

    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          : REAL;     (* Rollin superfluid film suppression collar heater [uW] *)

    (* Discrete Subsystem Digital Permissives & Contactor Demands *)

    bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  : BOOL;     (* Magnetic-bearing turbomolecular still pumping station run *)

    bEmergencyDumpValveOpen         : BOOL;     (* Failsafe high-speed recovery dump valve into expansion volume *)

    (* Supervisory Diagnostic Registers and Status Words *)
    wSystemStatusWord               : WORD;     (* Status: Bit0=Run, Bit1=TMR_Ok, Bit2=PotReady, Bit3=Condensing, Bit4=Separated, Bit5=MCDilution *)
    wFaultWord1                     : WORD;     (* Trip Faults: Bit0=EStop, Bit1=OVC_Vac, Bit2=Overpressure, Bit3=1KDryout, Bit4=StillRunaway *)
    wFaultWord2                     : WORD;     (* Diagnostic Faults: Bit0=StillTMR_Drift, Bit1=PotTMR_Drift, Bit2=FlowStall, Bit3=TrapClogged *)
    bSystemAlarm                    : BOOL;     (* Master summary audible/visual alarm annunciator *)
    bDegradedTMRActive              : BOOL;     (* Sensor operating in 1oo2 degraded configuration *)

    (* Validated Physical & Thermodynamic Telemetry *)
    rVotedStillTemp_mK              : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated Still temperature [mK] *)
    rVoted1KPotTemp_K               : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated 1-Kelvin Pot temperature [K] *)
    rEstimatedCoolingPowerMC_uW     : REAL;     (* Calculated instantaneous dilution cooling power at MC [uW] *)
    rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct        : REAL;     (* Real-time Raoult-Dalton estimated 3He vapor phase purity [%] *)
    rCryoTrapImpedanceIndex         : REAL;     (* Normalized flow impedance ratio across cold traps [mbar / (umol/s)] *)
    iSequenceStep                   : INT;      (* Current active cryogenic phase state index *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR INTERNALS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    bStillChanA_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    bStillChanB_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    bStillChanC_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    rStillDiff_AB                   : REAL := 0.0;
    rStillDiff_BC                   : REAL := 0.0;
    rStillDiff_CA                   : REAL := 0.0;
    iStillHealthyCount              : INT  := 3;

    bPotChanA_Valid                 : BOOL := TRUE;
    bPotChanB_Valid                 : BOOL := TRUE;
    bPotChanC_Valid                 : BOOL := TRUE;
    rPotDiff_AB                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rPotDiff_BC                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rPotDiff_CA                     : REAL := 0.0;
    iPotHealthyCount                : INT  := 3;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       STATE-SPACE MATRICES & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) KERNEL
       State vector x = [ Delta T_still [mK], Delta n_dot_3 [umol/s], Delta T_1K [mK], Delta P_cond [mbar] ]^T
       Control vector u = [ Delta Q_still [uW], Delta u_JT [%] ]^T
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    aStateVector                    : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL; (* x(k) *)
    aStateSetpoint                  : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL; (* x_ref *)
    aControlVector                  : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL; (* u(k) *)
    aControlPrev                    : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL; (* u(k-1) *)
    aControlDelta                   : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL; (* Delta u(k) *)
    aGradientVector                 : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL; (* Gradient g = del J / del u *)

    (* Discrete Plant Transition Matrix A_d (4x4) for Ts = 100 ms *)
    aMatrix_A                       : ARRAY[1..4, 1..4] OF REAL := [
        [0.9885, -0.0125,  0.0042,  0.0018],    (* Row 1: d(T_still)/dt dynamics *)
        [0.0450,  0.9620,  0.0010,  0.0820],    (* Row 2: d(n_dot_3)/dt dynamics *)
        [0.0008, -0.0002,  0.9780,  0.0065],    (* Row 3: d(T_1K)/dt dynamics    *)
        [-0.0150, -0.1250, 0.0420,  0.9410]     (* Row 4: d(P_cond)/dt dynamics  *)
    ];

    (* Discrete Control Input Matrix B_d (4x2) for Ts = 100 ms *)
    aMatrix_B                       : ARRAY[1..4, 1..2] OF REAL := [
        [ 0.01450, -0.00320 ],                  (* Input 1: Q_still heater -> T_still, n_dot_3, T_1K, P_cond *)
        [ 0.02850,  0.04800 ],                  (* Input 2: JT valve position -> T_still, n_dot_3, T_1K, P_cond *)
        [ 0.00012,  0.00840 ],
        [-0.00450, -0.18500 ]
    ];

    (* MPC Quadratic Cost Weighting Diagonal Matrices *)
    aWeight_Q                       : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL := [1.250, 0.850, 2.400, 0.650]; (* State error penalties *)
    aWeight_R                       : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL := [0.004, 0.012];               (* Actuator effort penalties *)
    aWeight_S                       : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL := [0.050, 0.150];               (* Actuator slew rate penalties *)

    (* Projected Gradient Descent Solver Parameters *)
    c_iMPC_MaxIter                  : INT  := 8;
    c_rMPC_Alpha                    : REAL := 0.085;    (* Optimization step size *)

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       THERMODYNAMIC EQUATIONS & RAOULT-DALTON ESTIMATION REGISTERS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rP_sat3_mbar                    : REAL := 0.0;
    rP_sat4_mbar                    : REAL := 0.0;
    rLiquidConcentrationHe3         : REAL := 0.012;    (* 1.2% typical 3He concentration in still liquid *)
    rTempStillKelvin                : REAL := 0.700;
    rRollinFilmCreepRate_umol_s     : REAL := 0.0;
    rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW       : REAL := 0.0;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       DIGITAL FILTER ACCUMULATORS & SLEW RATE LIMITERS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK      : REAL := 20.0;
    rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s : REAL := 0.0;
    rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar   : REAL := 0.0;
    rSlewLimitedStillPower_uW       : REAL := 0.0;
    rSlewLimitedJTValve_pct         : REAL := 0.0;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       TIMERS & WATCHDOG REGISTERS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    tStepWatchdog                   : TON;
    tPrecoolStabilityTimer          : TON;
    tCondensationStabilizeTimer     : TON;
    tPhaseSeparationSearchTimer     : TON;
    tAlarmDelayTimer                : TON;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       INTERNAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 PHASES)
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    iState                          : INT  := 0;
    iPrevState                      : INT  := 0;
    bStateFirstScan                 : BOOL := TRUE;
    rActiveTargetStillTemp_mK       : REAL := 700.0;
    rActiveTarget1KPotTemp_K        : REAL := 1.300;
    rActiveTargetCircFlow_umol_s    : REAL := 300.0;
    rActiveTargetCondPress_mbar     : REAL := 600.0;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       ITERATION INDICES & LOCAL SCRATCHPAD
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    i                               : INT;
    j                               : INT;
    k_iter                          : INT;
    rPredictedState                 : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;
    rStateError                     : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;
    rCandidateControl               : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       PHYSICAL & CRYOGENIC PROCESS CONSTANTS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK      : REAL := 25.0;     (* Max RuO2 channel discrepancy before quarantine [mK] *)
    c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K        : REAL := 0.080;    (* Max 1K Pot channel discrepancy before quarantine [K] *)
    c_rMaxAllowableCondPress_mbar   : REAL := 1600.0;   (* Compressor discharge relief threshold [mbar] *)
    c_rCritOverpressureTrip_mbar    : REAL := 1850.0;   (* SIL-3 Rupture Disc Protection Trip [mbar] *)
    c_rMaxAllowableOVCVacuum_mbar   : REAL := 5.0E-3;   (* Cryostat thermal isolation vacuum limit [mbar] *)
    c_rMinCirculationFlow_umol_s    : REAL := 25.0;     (* Minimum flow to prevent capillary freezeout [umol/s] *)
    c_rMaxStillHeaterPower_uW       : REAL := 45000.0;  (* Max allowable Still resistive heat load [uW] *)
    c_rMaxFilmBurnerPower_uW        : REAL := 8000.0;   (* Max allowable Rollin film collar heat load [uW] *)
    c_rMaxStillTempRunaway_mK       : REAL := 1150.0;   (* Thermal runaway 4He boiling threshold [mK] *)
    c_rCycleDeltaT_s                : REAL := 0.100;    (* Periodic execution cycle period (100 ms) [s] *)
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC CONTROL LOGIC EXECUTION (SAMPLE PERIOD Ts = 100 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: SIL-3 HARDWIRED SAFETY CHAIN & IMMEDIATE TRIP HIERARCHY
   Cryogenic containment integrity, isotope conservation, and vacuum thermal boundary protection
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEStopOk OR bEmergencyDumpCmd THEN
    (* Immediate De-Energization of all cryogenic heaters to prevent violent liquid boiloff *)
    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
    rCmdJTValvePosition_pct         := 0.0; (* Lock J-T needle valve *)
    rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct   := 100.0; (* Relieve high-pressure head *)

    (* Shut down high-vacuum pumps and compressor *)
    bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := FALSE;
    bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := FALSE;
    bCryoTrapRegenHeaterCmd         := FALSE;

    (* Isolate storage dump tanks and open emergency expansion recovery valves *)
    bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := TRUE;
    bEmergencyDumpValveOpen         := TRUE;

    wFaultWord1.0                   := NOT bEStopOk;
    wFaultWord1.1                   := bEmergencyDumpCmd;
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord               := 16#F000;
    iState                          := 999; (* Transition directly to emergency dump state *)
    iSequenceStep                   := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical Outer Vacuum Chamber (OVC) Insulation Vacuum Breach Protection *)
IF (rOVCVacuumPressure_mbar > c_rMaxAllowableOVCVacuum_mbar) THEN
    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
    bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := FALSE;
    bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := FALSE;
    bEmergencyDumpValveOpen         := TRUE; (* Recover precious 3He gas before thermal conduction warms cold stages *)
    wFaultWord1.2                   := TRUE; (* OVC Vacuum Loss *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    iState                          := 999;
END_IF;

(* High-Pressure Condensing Return Line Overpressure Trip (Isotope Containment Protection) *)
IF (rCondensingPressure_mbar > c_rCritOverpressureTrip_mbar) THEN
    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
    rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct   := 100.0; (* Full open bypass to dump tanks *)
    bEmergencyDumpValveOpen         := TRUE;
    wFaultWord1.3                   := TRUE; (* Overpressure trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    iState                          := 999;
END_IF;

(* 1-Kelvin Pot Liquid Dryout Protection under Active Compressor Operation *)
IF (iState >= 40) AND (iState <= 70) AND (r1KPotLiquidLevel_pct < 4.0) AND (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K > 2.20) THEN
    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
    wFaultWord1.4                   := TRUE; (* 1K Pot Dryout Trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    iState                          := 999;
END_IF;

(* Still Thermal Runaway Protection (Excessive 4He Distillation Collapse) *)
IF (rStillTempTMR_A_mK > c_rMaxStillTempRunaway_mK) OR (rStillPressure_mbar > 0.35) THEN
    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
    wFaultWord1.5                   := TRUE; (* Still Runaway Trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    iState                          := 999;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: DUAL TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES
   Provides fault tolerance for Ruthenium Oxide Still bridges and 1K Pot Ge/Cernox thermometers
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- 2.1: Still RuO2 4-Wire Resistance Bridge 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bStillChanA_Valid := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK >= 100.0) AND (rStillTempTMR_A_mK <= 2500.0);
bStillChanB_Valid := (rStillTempTMR_B_mK >= 100.0) AND (rStillTempTMR_B_mK <= 2500.0);
bStillChanC_Valid := (rStillTempTMR_C_mK >= 100.0) AND (rStillTempTMR_C_mK <= 2500.0);

rStillDiff_AB := ABS(rStillTempTMR_A_mK - rStillTempTMR_B_mK);
rStillDiff_BC := ABS(rStillTempTMR_B_mK - rStillTempTMR_C_mK);
rStillDiff_CA := ABS(rStillTempTMR_C_mK - rStillTempTMR_A_mK);

IF bStillChanA_Valid AND bStillChanB_Valid AND bStillChanC_Valid THEN
    IF (rStillDiff_AB <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) AND 
       (rStillDiff_BC <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) AND 
       (rStillDiff_CA <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) THEN
        (* Case A: Perfect 3-Channel Consensus -> Middle Value Selection (Median Voting) *)
        rVotedStillTemp_mK := rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_B_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK
                              - MIN(rStillTempTMR_A_mK, MIN(rStillTempTMR_B_mK, rStillTempTMR_C_mK))
                              - MAX(rStillTempTMR_A_mK, MAX(rStillTempTMR_B_mK, rStillTempTMR_C_mK));
        iStillHealthyCount := 3;
        bDegradedTMRActive := FALSE;
        wFaultWord2.0      := FALSE;

    ELSIF (rStillDiff_BC <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) AND (rStillDiff_AB > c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) THEN
        (* Case B: Channel A drifted / noisy -> Quarantine Channel A, Degrade to 1oo2 of (B, C) *)
        rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_B_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK) * 0.5;
        iStillHealthyCount := 2;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rStillDiff_CA <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) AND (rStillDiff_AB > c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) THEN
        (* Case C: Channel B drifted / noisy -> Quarantine Channel B, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, C) *)
        rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK) * 0.5;
        iStillHealthyCount := 2;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rStillDiff_AB <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) AND (rStillDiff_BC > c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) THEN
        (* Case D: Channel C drifted / noisy -> Quarantine Channel C, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, B) *)
        rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_B_mK) * 0.5;
        iStillHealthyCount := 2;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

    ELSE
        (* Case E: Multi-sensor divergence across Still sensors -> Fallback to conservative average & raise alarm *)
        rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_B_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK) / 3.0;
        iStillHealthyCount := 0;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;
        bSystemAlarm       := TRUE;
    END_IF;

ELSIF bStillChanB_Valid AND bStillChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_B_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK) * 0.5;
    iStillHealthyCount := 2;
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

ELSIF bStillChanA_Valid AND bStillChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK) * 0.5;
    iStillHealthyCount := 2;
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

ELSIF bStillChanA_Valid AND bStillChanB_Valid THEN
    rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_B_mK) * 0.5;
    iStillHealthyCount := 2;
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Bank Failure on Still Stage *)
    rVotedStillTemp_mK := 800.0; (* Fallback nominal estimate *)
    iStillHealthyCount := 0;
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm       := TRUE;
    iState             := 999;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2: 1-Kelvin Pot Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bPotChanA_Valid := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K >= 0.800) AND (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K <= 30.00);
bPotChanB_Valid := (r1KPotTempTMR_B_K >= 0.800) AND (r1KPotTempTMR_B_K <= 30.00);
bPotChanC_Valid := (r1KPotTempTMR_C_K >= 0.800) AND (r1KPotTempTMR_C_K <= 30.00);

rPotDiff_AB := ABS(r1KPotTempTMR_A_K - r1KPotTempTMR_B_K);
rPotDiff_BC := ABS(r1KPotTempTMR_B_K - r1KPotTempTMR_C_K);
rPotDiff_CA := ABS(r1KPotTempTMR_C_K - r1KPotTempTMR_A_K);

IF bPotChanA_Valid AND bPotChanB_Valid AND bPotChanC_Valid THEN
    IF (rPotDiff_AB <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) AND 
       (rPotDiff_BC <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) AND 
       (rPotDiff_CA <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) THEN
        rVoted1KPotTemp_K := r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_B_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K
                             - MIN(r1KPotTempTMR_A_K, MIN(r1KPotTempTMR_B_K, r1KPotTempTMR_C_K))
                             - MAX(r1KPotTempTMR_A_K, MAX(r1KPotTempTMR_B_K, r1KPotTempTMR_C_K));
        iPotHealthyCount  := 3;
        wFaultWord2.1     := FALSE;

    ELSIF (rPotDiff_BC <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) AND (rPotDiff_AB > c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) THEN
        rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_B_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K) * 0.5;
        iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
        wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rPotDiff_CA <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) AND (rPotDiff_AB > c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) THEN
        rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K) * 0.5;
        iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
        wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rPotDiff_AB <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) AND (rPotDiff_BC > c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) THEN
        rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_B_K) * 0.5;
        iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
        wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

    ELSE
        rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_B_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K) / 3.0;
        iPotHealthyCount  := 0;
        wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;
        bSystemAlarm      := TRUE;
    END_IF;

ELSIF bPotChanB_Valid AND bPotChanC_Valid THEN
    rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_B_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K) * 0.5;
    iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
    wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

ELSIF bPotChanA_Valid AND bPotChanC_Valid THEN
    rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K) * 0.5;
    iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
    wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

ELSIF bPotChanA_Valid AND bPotChanB_Valid THEN
    rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_B_K) * 0.5;
    iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
    wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

ELSE
    rVoted1KPotTemp_K := 1.40;
    iPotHealthyCount  := 0;
    wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm      := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: THERMODYNAMIC PHYSICAL PROPERTY ESTIMATORS & CRYOGENIC PROCESS KINETICS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Digital First-Order Low-Pass Filter on Process Telemetry to eliminate AC bridge excitation noise *)
rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK      := (0.15 * rMixChamberTemp_mK) + (0.85 * rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK);
rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s := (0.20 * rHe3CirculationFlow_umol_s) + (0.80 * rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s);
rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar   := (0.25 * rCondensingPressure_mbar) + (0.75 * rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar);

(* Real-Time Isotopic Vapor Pressure Equations (Antoine / Roberts-Sydoriak Parametrization) *)
rTempStillKelvin := rVotedStillTemp_mK * 1.0E-3;
IF rTempStillKelvin > 0.400 THEN
    (* 3He Saturated Vapor Pressure Estimation [mbar] *)
    rP_sat3_mbar := EXP(2.450 - (2.165 / rTempStillKelvin));

    (* 4He Saturated Vapor Pressure Estimation [mbar] *)
    rP_sat4_mbar := EXP(3.120 - (5.320 / rTempStillKelvin));

    (* Dalton-Raoult Vapor Phase Concentration Estimation [%] *)
    IF (rP_sat3_mbar > 0.0) AND ((rP_sat3_mbar + rP_sat4_mbar) > 0.0) THEN
        rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct := ((rP_sat3_mbar * rLiquidConcentrationHe3) / 
                                    ((rP_sat3_mbar * rLiquidConcentrationHe3) + (rP_sat4_mbar * (1.0 - rLiquidConcentrationHe3)))) * 100.0;
        IF rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct > 99.5 THEN
            rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct := 99.5;
        ELSIF rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct < 10.0 THEN
            rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct := 10.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct := 95.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rP_sat3_mbar := 0.001;
    rP_sat4_mbar := 0.00001;
    rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct := 98.0;
END_IF;

(* Theoretical Instantaneous Dilution Cooling Power at Mixing Chamber *)
(* Q_dot_MC = 84.0 * n_dot_3 * T_MC^2 [J/s = W] -> Scaled to micro-Watts [uW] *)
IF rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK < 800.0 THEN
    rEstimatedCoolingPowerMC_uW := 8.4E-5 * rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s * (rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK * rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK);
ELSE
    rEstimatedCoolingPowerMC_uW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Rollin Superfluid 4He Creeping Film Flow Rate and Required Film Burner Collar Power *)
(* Creeping film is driven up still pumping throat; heater evaporates film back into still base *)
IF (rVotedStillTemp_mK >= 550.0) AND (rVotedStillTemp_mK <= 950.0) THEN
    rRollinFilmCreepRate_umol_s := 45.0 * (1.0 - (rVotedStillTemp_mK / 2170.0)); (* Lambda point 2.17 K *)
    rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW   := rRollinFilmCreepRate_umol_s * 21.0 * 1.5;     (* 21 J/mol latent heat * safety margin *)
    IF rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW > c_rMaxFilmBurnerPower_uW THEN
        rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW := c_rMaxFilmBurnerPower_uW;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Cryotrap Normalized Flow Resistance Index: Delta P / flow *)
IF rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s > 10.0 THEN
    rCryoTrapImpedanceIndex := rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar / rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s;
    IF rCryoTrapImpedanceIndex > 15.0 THEN
        wFaultWord2.3 := TRUE; (* Cold trap clogging / restriction warning *)
    ELSE
        wFaultWord2.3 := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCryoTrapImpedanceIndex := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: STATE-SPACE MULTI-INPUT MULTI-OUTPUT (MIMO) MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) KERNEL
   4 States: x = [ Delta T_still, Delta n_dot_3, Delta T_1K, Delta P_cond ]^T
   2 Controls: u = [ Delta Q_still, Delta u_JT ]^T
   Quadratic optimization via iterative projected gradient descent
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Assemble Error State Vector: x(k) = Current - Target *)
aStateVector[1] := rVotedStillTemp_mK - rActiveTargetStillTemp_mK;
aStateVector[2] := rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s - rActiveTargetCircFlow_umol_s;
aStateVector[3] := (rVoted1KPotTemp_K - rActiveTarget1KPotTemp_K) * 1000.0; (* Scale to mK *)
aStateVector[4] := rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar - rActiveTargetCondPress_mbar;

(* Initialize Candidate Actuator Offsets from previous cycle *)
aCandidateControl[1] := aControlPrev[1];
aCandidateControl[2] := aControlPrev[2];

(* Projected Gradient Descent Iterative Optimization Loop *)
FOR k_iter := 1 TO c_iMPC_MaxIter DO

    (* Step A: Predict 1-step State Horizon: x_hat = A_d * x + B_d * u *)
    FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
        rPredictedState[i] := 0.0;
        FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
            rPredictedState[i] := rPredictedState[i] + (aMatrix_A[i, j] * aStateVector[j]);
        END_FOR;
        FOR j := 1 TO 2 DO
            rPredictedState[i] := rPredictedState[i] + (aMatrix_B[i, j] * aCandidateControl[j]);
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Step B: Compute Cost Gradient del J / del u = B^T * Q * x_hat + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
    FOR j := 1 TO 2 DO
        aGradientVector[j] := 0.0;
        FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
            aGradientVector[j] := aGradientVector[j] + (aMatrix_B[i, j] * aWeight_Q[i] * rPredictedState[i]);
        END_FOR;
        aGradientVector[j] := aGradientVector[j] + (aWeight_R[j] * aCandidateControl[j]);
        aGradientVector[j] := aGradientVector[j] + (aWeight_S[j] * (aCandidateControl[j] - aControlPrev[j]));

        (* Step C: Descend along negative gradient with step size alpha *)
        aCandidateControl[j] := aCandidateControl[j] - (c_rMPC_Alpha * aGradientVector[j]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Step D: Project onto Permissible Actuator Physical Operating Boundaries *)
    (* Control 1: Still Heater Power Offset [uW] *)
    IF aCandidateControl[1] > 25000.0 THEN
        aCandidateControl[1] := 25000.0;
    ELSIF aCandidateControl[1] < -25000.0 THEN
        aCandidateControl[1] := -25000.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Control 2: JT Needle Valve Position Offset [%] *)
    IF aCandidateControl[2] > 40.0 THEN
        aCandidateControl[2] := 40.0;
    ELSIF aCandidateControl[2] < -40.0 THEN
        aCandidateControl[2] := -40.0;
    END_IF;

END_FOR;

(* Store Solution for next cycle *)
aControlPrev[1] := aCandidateControl[1];
aControlPrev[2] := aCandidateControl[2];

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 AUTOMATED CRYOGENIC PHASES)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_PUMPED_VAC: System stationary, room temperature / pre-checks *)
        rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
        rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
        rCmdJTValvePosition_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct   := 0.0;
        bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := FALSE;
        bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := FALSE;
        bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := FALSE;
        bCryoTrapRegenHeaterCmd         := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDumpValveOpen         := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#0001; (* Standby Ready *)

        IF bEnable AND bEStopOk AND (wFaultWord1 = 0) AND bStartAutoSequence THEN
            iState := 10; (* Advance to Pulse Tube Precooling Phase *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_PRECOOL_PT_EXCHANGE: Pulse Tube cryocooler running, precooling 50K and 4K plates *)
        rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
        rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
        rCmdJTValvePosition_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct   := 0.0;
        bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := FALSE;
        bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := FALSE;
        bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#0003;

        (* Interlock: Wait until Pulse Tube 2nd stage reaches < 3.8 K and OVC vacuum is pristine *)
        IF (rPulseTube4KStageTemp_K <= 3.80) AND (rOVCVacuumPressure_mbar <= 1.0E-4) THEN
            tPrecoolStabilityTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#120S);
            IF tPrecoolStabilityTimer.Q THEN
                tPrecoolStabilityTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 20; (* Advance to 1K Pot Pumping and Filling *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tPrecoolStabilityTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_1K_POT_PUMPDOWN_AND_FILL: Establish 1K Pot continuous precooling stage at ~1.3 K *)
        rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
        rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#0007;

        (* Crack open J-T metering valve to fill 1K Pot with liquid 4He *)
        rActiveTarget1KPotTemp_K := 1.300;
        rCmdJTValvePosition_pct  := 28.5 + (aCandidateControl[2] * 0.25);
        IF rCmdJTValvePosition_pct > 65.0 THEN
            rCmdJTValvePosition_pct := 65.0;
        ELSIF rCmdJTValvePosition_pct < 10.0 THEN
            rCmdJTValvePosition_pct := 10.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Verify 1K Pot liquid condensation and temperature stabilization *)
        IF (rVoted1KPotTemp_K <= 1.50) AND (r1KPotLiquidLevel_pct >= 45.0) THEN
            tCondensationStabilizeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#90S);
            IF tCondensationStabilizeTimer.Q THEN
                tCondensationStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 30; (* Advance to 3He/4He Mixture Condensation *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tCondensationStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_3HE_MIXTURE_CONDENSATION: Injecting isotopic mixture from dump tanks through 1K Pot condenser *)
        rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
        rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
        bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := TRUE;  (* Release mixture from dump tanks *)
        bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := TRUE;  (* Drive condensation loop *)
        bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#000F;

        (* Throttle J-T valve to maintain optimal condensation backpressure ~800 mbar *)
        rActiveTargetCondPress_mbar := 800.0;
        rCmdJTValvePosition_pct     := 35.0 + (aCandidateControl[2] * 0.40);
        rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct := 15.0;

        (* Check mixture inventory condensed into fridge: pressure drops as gas liquefies *)
        IF (rCondensingPressure_mbar <= 550.0) AND (rVoted1KPotTemp_K <= 1.45) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Advance to Circulation Bootstrap and Still Heating *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_CIRCULATION_BOOTSTRAP_STILL_RAMP: Start turbomolecular pump, activate Still distillation heater *)
        bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := TRUE;
        bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := TRUE;
        bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := TRUE;  (* Engage high-vacuum still pumping duct *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#001F;

        (* Ramp Still setpoint towards distillation plateau (700 mK) *)
        rActiveTargetStillTemp_mK   := 700.0;
        rActiveTargetCircFlow_umol_s := 250.0;
        rActiveTargetCondPress_mbar := 650.0;

        (* Apply Base Feedforward Still Heating + MPC Correction *)
        rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW := 12500.0 + aCandidateControl[1];
        IF rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW > c_rMaxStillHeaterPower_uW THEN
            rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW := c_rMaxStillHeaterPower_uW;
        ELSIF rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW < 100.0 THEN
            rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW := 100.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Modulate J-T needle valve for condensation balance *)
        rCmdJTValvePosition_pct := 42.0 + (aCandidateControl[2] * 0.50);
        rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW  := rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW;

        (* Criteria: 3He circulation flow established and Still temperature operating within 650-750 mK *)
        IF (rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s >= 150.0) AND 
           (rVotedStillTemp_mK >= 650.0) AND (rVotedStillTemp_mK <= 780.0) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Advance to Phase Separation Search in Mixing Chamber *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_PHASE_SEPARATION_SEARCH: Mixing chamber cooling through tricritical point (867 mK -> < 150 mK) *)
        bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := TRUE;
        bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := TRUE;
        bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#003F;

        (* Active MPC regulation of Still Distillation *)
        rActiveTargetStillTemp_mK    := rTargetStillTemp_mK;
        rActiveTargetCircFlow_umol_s := rTargetCirculationFlow_umol_s;
        rActiveTargetCondPress_mbar  := rTargetCondensingPress_mbar;

        rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW := 15000.0 + aCandidateControl[1];
        rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW  := rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW;
        rCmdJTValvePosition_pct := 45.0 + aCandidateControl[2];

        (* Detection of phase boundary formation: rapid drop of T_MC below 150 mK *)
        tPhaseSeparationSearchTimer(IN := (rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK <= 150.0), PT := T#180S);
        IF tPhaseSeparationSearchTimer.Q THEN
            tPhaseSeparationSearchTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 60; (* Phase boundary established! Transition to Continuous Millikelvin Steady State *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_CONTINUOUS_MILLIKELVIN_STEADY: Primary Quantum Computing Deep Cryogenic Regulating Regime *)
        bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := TRUE;
        bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := TRUE;
        bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#007F; (* Bit 6: Base MC Cooling Active *)

        (* Fully coupled State-Space MPC Active Control *)
        rActiveTargetStillTemp_mK    := rTargetStillTemp_mK;
        rActiveTarget1KPotTemp_K     := rTarget1KPotTemp_K;
        rActiveTargetCircFlow_umol_s := rTargetCirculationFlow_umol_s;
        rActiveTargetCondPress_mbar  := rTargetCondensingPress_mbar;

        (* Compute Slew-Limited Actuator Commands *)
        rSlewLimitedStillPower_uW := 18500.0 + aCandidateControl[1];
        IF rSlewLimitedStillPower_uW > c_rMaxStillHeaterPower_uW THEN
            rSlewLimitedStillPower_uW := c_rMaxStillHeaterPower_uW;
        ELSIF rSlewLimitedStillPower_uW < 500.0 THEN
            rSlewLimitedStillPower_uW := 500.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW := rSlewLimitedStillPower_uW;

        (* Film Burner Collar Heater Dynamic Feedback *)
        rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW  := rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW;

        (* J-T Needle Valve Proportional Regulation *)
        rSlewLimitedJTValve_pct := 48.0 + aCandidateControl[2];
        IF rSlewLimitedJTValve_pct > 95.0 THEN
            rSlewLimitedJTValve_pct := 95.0;
        ELSIF rSlewLimitedJTValve_pct < 15.0 THEN
            rSlewLimitedJTValve_pct := 15.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdJTValvePosition_pct := rSlewLimitedJTValve_pct;

        (* Low-frequency bypass trim to keep condensing line < 850 mbar *)
        IF rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar > 850.0 THEN
            rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct := (rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar - 850.0) * 0.15;
            IF rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct > 50.0 THEN
                rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct := 50.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* High quantum heat load condition: switch to Burst Cooldown *)
        IF rMixingChamberHeatLoad_uW > 45.0 THEN
            iState := 70;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_QUANTUM_BURST_COOLDOWN: Heavy Qubit Readout/Drive Pulse Heat Load Compensation *)
        bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := TRUE;
        bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := TRUE;
        bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#00FF;

        (* Boost 3He distillation circulation flow by increasing Still heating *)
        rActiveTargetCircFlow_umol_s := rTargetCirculationFlow_umol_s * 1.45; (* 45% circulation boost *)
        rActiveTargetStillTemp_mK    := rTargetStillTemp_mK + 45.0;

        rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW := 28500.0 + aCandidateControl[1];
        rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW  := rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW * 1.30;
        rCmdJTValvePosition_pct := 58.0 + aCandidateControl[2];

        (* Return to normal steady-state when quantum pulse heat load subsides *)
        IF rMixingChamberHeatLoad_uW <= 25.0 THEN
            iState := 60;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_WARMUP_RECOVERY: Safe cryogenic shutdown, mixture recovery into dump tanks *)
        rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
        rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
        rCmdJTValvePosition_pct         := 100.0; (* Full open J-T valve to empty traps *)
        rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct   := 100.0;
        bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := TRUE;  (* Compressor pumps mixture back into tanks *)
        bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := TRUE;
        bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#01FF;

        (* Mixture recovery complete when cryostat internal pressure drops < 0.10 mbar *)
        IF (rStillPressure_mbar <= 0.10) AND (rCondensingPressure_mbar <= 10.0) THEN
            bHe3CompressorRunCmd           := FALSE;
            bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd := FALSE;
            bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen    := FALSE;
            iState := 0; (* Return to standby *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* STATE_CRYOGENIC_EMERGENCY_DUMP: Hardware trip, overpressure relief, and failsafe isolation *)
        rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
        rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
        rCmdJTValvePosition_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct   := 100.0;
        bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := FALSE;
        bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := FALSE;
        bCryoTrapRegenHeaterCmd         := FALSE;
        bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := TRUE;
        bEmergencyDumpValveOpen         := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#F999;

        (* Reset latch: requires operator reset, healthy safety loop, and normalized condensing pressure *)
        IF bResetAlarms AND bEStopOk AND (rCondensingPressure_mbar < 1000.0) AND (rOVCVacuumPressure_mbar < 1.0E-3) THEN
            wFaultWord1             := 0;
            wFaultWord2             := 0;
            bSystemAlarm            := FALSE;
            bEmergencyDumpValveOpen := FALSE;
            iState                  := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* Update Sequence Status Output *)
iSequenceStep := iState;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
